scope: Read-only audit of the final bounded outbound scalar and producer v5 implementations and synthetic/development tests. No new candidate metadata, source, or patch was examined.

specified_boundary_checks.boundary: u32 storage initialized with cpu_to_le32 is not reported as raw unencoded host bytes
specified_boundary_checks.basis: test_host_storage_with_explicit_encoding_is_not_raw_host; host_source_proof refuses conversion or unknown-call provenance

specified_boundary_checks.boundary: __le32 source passed through cpu_to_le32 again is not reported as matched normal encoding
specified_boundary_checks.basis: test_double_encoding_not_matched_normal; conversion source proof requires one unique u32 host declaration

specified_boundary_checks.boundary: consumer mutates payload through an alias or cast before forwarding
specified_boundary_checks.basis: test_consumer_alias_cast_content_write_refuses and test_consumer_direct_cast_content_write_refuses; consumer proof requires a unique direct pointer use

specified_boundary_checks.boundary: conditional endian pointer member must not be silently filtered as a proven pointer-object assignment
specified_boundary_checks.basis: test_single_conditional_member_is_not_filtered_as_proven and test_outer_conditional_struct_is_not_a_proven_shape; v5 filters only when shape.status=proven

limits: This pass covers the specified synthetic boundaries and the two modules' existing development suites; it is not a general C parser soundness proof.
The outbound consumer proof assumes standard Linux memcpy/conversion semantics, cannot resolve arbitrary macros, aliases, casts, complete preprocessing, or all control-flow paths.
In the reviewed hci historical source, unknown CONFIG_SERIAL_DEV_BUS keeps the overall finding insufficient even where local scalar and byte-copy evidence are available.
Producer v5 treats a canonical outer header guard as an inventory assumption, not a proof of actual include order or active configuration.
